purpose: Official API references consulted for native content-sized user bubbles; these do not prove runtime or pixel correctness.
implementation: The opt-in user branch measures attributed natural width, caps it at the proposed width and asks the same native text view for fitted height. Default source/lookup readers keep the full proposed width. Apple documentation Markdown fetching returned unsupported-content-type for size(); the public SDK/build and native checks remain the implementation authority.
